licensing: Public IndCat bibliographic metadata search is observed. Repository full-text license, metadata redistribution rights and item reading conditions remain separate and unverified.
limitations: Scope is the explicitly Shodhganga-linked subset indexed by IndCat, not the whole Shodhganga repository. Shared IndCat metadata is not another independent origin.

First20 provider records only; filtered empty does not prove catalog-wide absence. Paging, refresh, later-day reliability and broader language coverage unverified.
A nonsense-query control returned HTTP200 but omitted the expected form echo; parser rejected it. Empty-result semantics remain unverified and are not represented as catalog-wide absence.

analysis_refs.heading: C06 — Theses and dissertations
analysis_refs.text: | India | Begin with Shodhganga through [INFLIBNET's official initiatives](https://www.inflibnet.ac.in/activities/), then follow university links. Use the official university directory's state/category browsing to fill geographic gaps. [IndCat's documented features](https://indcat.inflibnet.ac.in/index.php/main/features) include thesis discovery and Shodhganga links, but a bibliographic record is not itself a readable thesis. |

analysis_refs.heading: Credentials and implementation inputs
analysis_refs.text: Assumptions: global discovery with explicit language/country context; lawful public hosts; verified free source login is allowed (owner clarification 2026-11-01), labelled separately from anonymous reading; no full-text hosting, subscription purchases, or library-card integration. Existing India library coverage makes NCERT, DIKSHA, StoryWeaver and Shodhganga useful follow-ups, but their discovery integrations are not assumed ready.

analysis_refs.heading: Shodhganga metadata recovered through IndCat
analysis_refs.text: INFLIBNET’s feature documentation describes Shodhganga links, and its thesis form includes an explicit Shodhganga checkbox. That independently published search returns native repository handles alongside separate IndCat thesis IDs. Ten distinct title queries now pass. No request followed a Shodhganga link, and repository restrictions remain in force.

analysis_refs.heading: Shodhganga metadata recovered through IndCat
analysis_refs.text: The verified mode uses the published All Fields keyword form with Shodhganga filtering, then requires every literal title token. An initial title-field request rendered All Fields; this mismatch is saved and no server-side title-only promise is made. The parser rejects ambiguous/missing/duplicate native mappings and retains original reported links. Scope is first20 indexed records, not whole-repository coverage, reading access or a new independent origin.
